# betterado_serviceendpoint_generic_v2 (Data Source)

Use this data source to access information about an existing Generic V2 Service Connection within Azure DevOps.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "betterado_serviceendpoint_generic_v2" "example" {
  project_id = betterado_project.example.id
  name       = "Example Generic V2 Service Connection"
}

output "serviceendpoint_id" {
  value = data.betterado_serviceendpoint_generic_v2.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project.

### Optional

- `id` (String) The ID of the service endpoint. Exactly one of id or name must be specified.
- `name` (String) The name of the service endpoint. Exactly one of id or name must be specified.

### Read-Only

- `authorization_parameters` (Map of String) A map of authorization parameters for the service connection.
- `authorization_scheme` (String) The authorization scheme used for the service connection.
- `data` (Map of String) A map of endpoint-specific data parameters.
- `description` (String) The Service Endpoint description.
- `server_url` (String) The server URL of the service connection.
- `type` (String) The type of the service endpoint.
